description: Bron van het drinkwater is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. Deze kaart laat zien waar ons water uit de kraan vandaan komt. In Nederland wordt drinkwater gemaakt van grondwater, rivierwater of oevergrondwater. Tien Nederlandse drinkwaterbedrijven zuiveren dit water tot schoon en veilig drinkwater. Rivierwater komt uit grote rivieren of meren, zoals de Rijn, Maas of het IJsselmeer. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are drinkwater, grondwater, water. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WFS_SRVC, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC. The portal shows 2026-08-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
